label: two charges at Claywater
intent: hook: both banks charge more this season for one stop; the landing's clay cut below the ford has a crocodile in it and the rains are close; sends the player to Livia Varinius at the well and Signs-For-The-Cargo at the raft

label: two charges at Claywater
intent: the station's side: two drakes a traveller this season for the stop and its water, to pay a mason to re-line the cracked well in stone, since the landing would not haul stone; she takes the two drakes from the player (takeGold 2) or names the price; the landing's new charge is on walkers who wade a ford anyone can wade, and she has never charged the landing for water

label: two charges at Claywater
intent: the landing's side: a drake a head now to wade, more by the wheel for a cart on the raft; he takes the drake from the player (takeGold 1) or names it; the ford was worked before the well was dug; the landing does not drink the well's water or haul stone for it; there is a price for walkers to go free (the line grants topic.lf83-ford-charge)

label: two charges at Claywater
intent: the station's case as Gaius Vibius makes it (written for the packet that places him, not Part 1): the station keeps its own pot and its stone; the landing's new charge is spite

label: the landing's terms
intent: what the landing would give: no stone ever, but the landing's way with any wall on this bank, clay pressed in behind it, which moves with the bank and holds; there is no clay, because the crocodile has the cut, and the rains are close. Pressed at disposition 30 or more, he admits he set the walkers' charge when the station raised its own (k11), and says Takes-The-Short-Weight told him it was wrong (k13)

label: the landing's terms
intent: her objection: a mason's stone will mend the well; the landing would take half a charge for water it never draws, since its people draw only to wash and she charges them nothing

label: the failing well
intent: at disposition 30 or more: she will tell what is wrong with the station's water if the player brings her a bucket of it (sets flag.lf83.taste-asked); with the bucket she tastes it against the ford water by her door and says it is the ford coming in (takes item.bucket, sets flag.lf83.ford-tasted); clay holds where stone cracks; the walkers' charge answered the station's rise and sends travellers to the crocodile, and she told the poler so; Livia keeps what the bucket brings up in a jar, and writes everything in her book. Below 30: she will not talk against her own bank to a stranger, and says so

label: the failing well
intent: until the player has found why (no objectiveComplete why-failing): the head has a crack the mason will mend, and the water is only low after a dry season. Once the player has found it: she admits the ford comes in, that the stone has cracked every year and she has mended it herself each dry season; the line grants topic.lf83-stop-charge

label: the clay bend
intent: the landing digs its plaster clay at the cut below the ford, on the station bank, as it did before the well; a crocodile has the deep pool under it and comes up at anyone on the cut; nobody has dug for ten days; the landing will hear terms from whoever gives it back its cut; ask Takes-The-Short-Weight, who tastes everything, what ails the station's water (k13)

label: the clay bend
intent: once the crocodile is dead (not npcAlive the crocodile), he admits he dropped the basket at the cut and ran

label: the clay bend
intent: at disposition 30 or more: travellers slip along the station bank at night and wade at the swing below the ford, where the crocodile lies; their prints are in the clay at dawn; the landing has dug its clay there since before the well

label: one charge for the stop
intent: the settlement: one charge for the stop, shared between the banks, the landing's clay pressed in behind the head. She agrees (the line sets flag.lf83.one-charge-station) when both her objections are answered (shapeData.objections); otherwise she gives the open objection and the line grants topic.lf83-stop-charge

label: one charge for the stop
intent: the settlement as the landing hears it. He agrees when both his objections are answered (shapeData.objections): the line takes item.lf83.clay-basket and sets flag.lf83.one-charge-landing, the landing's promise of clay and hands; otherwise he gives the open objection

label: the ford charge
intent: the obvious option: for a hundred drakes he takes no charge from walkers this season; with goldAtLeast 100 the agreeing line takes the gold (takeGold 100) and sets flag.lf83.ford-charge-bought; without it he names the price

label: the station's charge
intent: back the landing: once the player has found why the well fails (objectiveComplete why-failing) and her disposition is 50 or more after intimidation, she drops her charge back to the old drake rather than have the yearly mending known (sets flag.lf83.stop-charge-dropped); before then she defends the charge

label: latest rumours
intent: hook: guests are falling sick and people blame his food; below 40 he keeps his thoughts from strangers and says so

label: sickness at the spring
intent: he thinks something is in the spring, not his pot; only Im-Moro may go into the pool; ask her, or test the water

label: sickness at the spring
intent: it is the travellers' food; shown the test or the sick guests she grants the player leave to go in, once

label: the body in the spring
intent: she has seen it now; she will have it raised once the killer is named

label: the body in the spring
intent: at first the courier left without paying; shown the rope or the body he admits the pack is in his store

label: the body in the spring
intent: a stake carries the dead person's story; a blank one means the killer knew the custom and chose not to honour the dead

label: the body in the spring
intent: friendly and helpful; blames the fire stand's food and points at Tsono-Ra

label: what the households said
intent: he knows his knot; at first evasive; at disposition 40 or shown the rope he admits selling it late to Reeh-Shaal

label: accuse
intent: available with two exhibits (shapeData.accusation); she breaks and admits it, naming the packet

label: accuse
intent: the wrong accusation: he is shamed and says nothing more

label: the sick root
intent: the Conclave's commission: the Hist is sickening, the village blames the salt works; he stopped buying their salt a year ago

label: the sick root
intent: the salt works foul her spring; nothing of Greenspring's does

label: the sick root
intent: the leaves and the sap; he will not guess the cause

label: the cut in the roots
intent: shown the tool-marks he reads the founders' stakes aloud and names the dead grove

label: the cut in the roots
intent: the Conclave must hear it; he offers to pay for the sealing if the founders stay unnamed
